meta.name: triage
meta.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles — categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分类和验证 issue 与 PR，生成 agent 可用简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要手动分类和验证 GitHub issue 与外部 PR
copy.tagline_en: Automatically categorize and verify issues and PRs, generate agent-ready briefs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often manually categorize and verify GitHub issues and external PRs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你对 GitHub 议题和外部 PR 进行分类、验证、追问，并生成供 AI 或人类处理的摘要。它会按状态（如待分类、待补充信息、可执行等）管理这些请求。
howto.when: 当维护者输入 `/triage` 并描述需求时触发，例如“看看 #42”或“显示需要我关注的内容”。

say.note: Claude 会分析议题并给出分类建议。

say.text: 显示所有待分类的议题。
say.note: Claude 会列出未分类和待处理的议题。
Claude 会直接应用状态变更。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can classify, verify, grill, and write agent-ready briefs for GitHub issues and external PRs. It manages them through states like needs-triage, needs-info, ready-for-agent, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a maintainer types `/triage` and describes what they want, e.g., "Show me #42" or "What needs my attention?".

say_en.note: Claude will analyze and recommend a category and state.
Claude lists unlabeled and needs-triage items.
Claude applies the state override directly.
